ask.condition: root Ask with a positive Atom/And/Exists body after beta lowering; answer projection is embedded in Ask

modal.condition: opaque possible/necessary/likely wrapper; no modal fact semantics

multiplicity.condition: one is accepted only in the atomic reference profile; many has no grouping semantics

relative_time.condition: present Event references only, with an explicit UTC query instant; past and reference-time links are unsupported

question_evaluation.condition: only the bounded positive Ask profile; not arbitrary Question values

scope: representation and evaluation capability only; missing attributes remain unknown; no world-truth or quantifier-completeness claim
